content: What are the naming conventions for a section?
I have personally been doing like LinearOrderAndOtherPropertiesThisSectionIsAbout but I don't know if there is an official convention
I’ve seen lowerCamelCase for sections specifically quite often, or at least it seems that way!

Hmm, it seems my perception was skewed by the files I was recently touching. UpperCamelCase is the most prevalent, at 11387 occurrences, vs. 1773 total lowerCamelCase or lower_snake_case occurrences (by regex match for ^section [A-Z] or ^section [a-z]).

I’m guessing people are mostly just following the convention of the thing they’re naming the section after? I see lots of types in the uppercase-initial section names and lots of non-types in the lowercase-initial ones.
